title: Online Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting via Uncertainty-Driven Dual-Expert Calibration

problem.claim: Online forecasting for irregularly sampled multivariate time series with dynamically evolving missingness patterns.

gap.claim: Offline methods often degrade under online distribution shifts, while irregular sampling prevents relying on temporal continuity and periodicity used in regular multivariate time series.

contributions.claim: Under-Cali is an uncertainty-driven dual-expert calibration framework for online irregular multivariate time series forecasting.
The framework combines an uncertainty estimator, dual-expert calibration module, and adaptive routing module.
Adaptation uses a frozen source forecasting model and a lightweight, model-agnostic calibration module.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments on irregular multivariate time series benchmarks reportedly show consistent improvements with low computational cost.
The authors report that the framework enables efficient adaptation through lightweight calibration.

narrative_sequence.summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting is important because sampling is irregular and missingness evolves dynamically.
Offline methods degrade under online distribution shifts, and regular-series temporal characteristics are unavailable for irregular sampling.
Under-Cali addresses online forecasting with uncertainty estimation, dual experts, and adaptive routing.
Uncertainty routes difficult samples for calibration, while reliable samples update the reliable expert and estimator and challenging samples update the unreliable expert.
The source forecasting model remains frozen, and benchmark experiments reportedly show improvements at low computational cost.

unknowns: The abstract does not report datasets, numerical results, baselines, or evaluation protocol.
The abstract does not specify the uncertainty estimator, expert architectures, or routing criteria.
